## Linked Issue

Use `Fixes #...`, `Closes #...`, `Resolves #...`, or `Part of #...`.
Release-scope PRs must link an issue. `No issue needed:` is reserved for the
narrow mechanical changes allowed by `AGENTS.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue is present, or this is an eligible narrow mechanical change
      with `No issue needed:` explained.
- [ ] Docs are updated, or `No docs needed:` is explained.
- [ ] Focused tests were run and results are listed.
- [ ] `git diff --check` was run before commit.
- [ ] Public API, config parsing, path handling, artifact selection, and fallback/error semantics were reviewed where relevant.
